defects.what: A large stray anime girl's face fills the upper half of the lens view over the reef, although the shot should show only water, coral and the bronze glint.
Four lines of large gold pseudo-cursive words fill the notebook page above the drawn wave.
The open journal shows scribbled pseudo-text lines (the scene is writing, but the marks read as gibberish).
The dark marker plaque in front of Indio and M carries faint rows of pseudo-text.
The folded map under the key has tiny pseudo-labels near its edges.
The folk illustration is drawn with a cream border all round, a picture inside the frame.
The twelve datu medallions rising from the sand show smiling young women's faces instead of the datu.
